overview: The corner tower’s layouts respond to different orientations, including the community and Sheikh Zayed Road. The cited one-bedroom designs have a utility area, powder room and balcony, while the larger three-bedroom plan separates service accommodation.
research.locationNote: Within Sobha Central on Sheikh Zayed Road. Confirm the tower access, unit level and transport route; marketed city and sea-view labels apply to specific orientations.
research.priceNote: Bayut publishes AED 1.94m as launch price. The current official project page reviewed contains no live price list. This historical reference does not establish current stock or pricing of the expanded larger layouts.
research.paymentNote: Bayut and the broker project brief publish 60% during construction and 40% on completion. No verified dated developer calendar was retrieved; booking timing, construction milestones and transfer balances need a current unit-specific schedule.
research.handoverNote: Bayut gives Q4 2030; Property Finder instead reports January 2030. Mitchell’s attributes December 2031 to the wider Sobha Central register entry. That secondary register claim is not independently verified here, so no single confirmed headline date is assigned.
